programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s the bell-ringing-and-singing Pepper performing Twinkle, Twinkle like never heard before.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: It's snack time for Bing, but the only banana left is too mushy to eat. Flop suggests making a smoothie with it instead. Disaster strikes when Bing's carrot accidentally gets put into the blender as well and, when it gets shredded, Bing is upset to discover that his carrot has changed and that he can't have it back.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Laa-Laa and Po play a game of hide-and-seek. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dipsy are hiding too and Laa-Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Mo is upset when Tee accidentally breaks her favourite perfume. Tee is now determined to cheer her up by making her some new perfume from ingredients found around the house. Lucky Mo!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula’s cousin Nicky is visiting, something Bing is a little unsure about. Sula and Bing start making 'rippy pictures', and while Sula is looking for some purple paper Bing shows Nicky how to voosh the blue speedy car down the slide. However, Nicky vooshes too, falling and breaking his glasses! Sula is furious and Bing is forlorn. Amma soothes Bing while Nicky shows him that he can click his glasses back together again.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs rescuing from a stuck cable car. But when the car suddenly starts moving again, Mojo has to ride the cable to chase it down and save poor Preston.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Snake tells Slug to hurry up and join him for a new Squirrel Club adventure, Norrie counts shells on a beach, then it's time for a game! Finally, learn a skipping song with the Squirrels. Eugene teaches everyone how to create a song.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can’t figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea. A mobile library! The Squirrels set off with Duggee. Along the way, they help Tino find his creativity, King Tiger figure out his favourite ice cream flavour and Worm find her love of fantasy. The Squirrels learn just how helpful and informative a library can be!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Lucky’s dad changes the rules of pass the parcel back to having one prize in the middle.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Meet the Go Jetters, four explorers on a global adventure! In this animated adventure comedy series, plucky heroes Xuli, Kyan, Lars and Foz travel the world with their teacher Ubercorn - a disco-loving unicorn. When the Grandmaster Glitch's TV aerial breaks, he orders the Grimbots to take Lars's favourite landmark, the Eiffel Tower, and bolt it onto the top of Grim HQ instead. However, just as Grandmaster Glitch settles down to watch his favourite TV show, Hospital for Broken Hearts, the weight of the magnificent iron structure tips Grim HQ over and it plummets top-first into the ground. Whilst the Grimbots and Grandmaster Glitch do their best to stop them, the Go Jetters use their click-ons to release the Eiffel Tower from Grim HQ and get the famous Parisian landmark back into position.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Flopsy and Mopsy borrow Peter's journal, Peter has to save them from Old Brown - but will he lose his precious journal in the process?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. The Octonauts race against time to rescue Tweak's pal, a leatherback sea turtle, who is caught in a fast-moving ocean current that's sucking them into a whirlpool.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One of the bottles in Ten's collection accidentally falls off the wall, setting off a spectacular numbery hullabaloo. Learn to count down from ten by taking one away with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The Alphablocks need help to cross the bog to get the cog - what better than a pile of friendly animals? This episode has fun with the words hill, net, bog, cog, frog, hop, dog, dig, hog, jig, log, jog and box.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick’s making pizza for lunch, and Remie and Alva are sharing a slice or two. Norman finds out dogs can’t eat pizza, so the grandchildren have an idea - a special doggy pizza for Norman that he can share with his friends.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella is busy gardening, but Lift isn’t happy that she is making a mess with all that mud! Together, they set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. In the Cloud Kitchen, Patch makes a tasty treat with the Playtimers - Munchy Muddy Meadows, whilst in the Sing Song Forest, lots of muddy pictures are appearing in Tincy’s wondiferous web. In the Fortress of Fun, Kingsley and Queenie have a fun idea to play a game with the Playtimers called ‘The Muddy Pig Race’, but who will win, Team King or Team Queen?

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco and Charlie are playing at Bing's house when Coco spots the measuring lines on the wall that show how Bing has grown. Flop measures Bing, and he's bigger than the last time. When Bing can't reach his paper aeroplane, Coco offers to measure him again to check if he's really grown, but they don't quite get the measuring ritual right and the new mark is much lower than before. Bing gets scared that he's growing down and that if he keeps going he'll be as small as Charlie.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘frog’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see green, brown, hopping and croaking frogs, and one with a really long tongue! Dee looks for a frog that’s hiding and then relaxes with a clam frog. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu pops bubbles with ease but struggles to blow them.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Kitty asks the Piggies to build a bouncing machine for her and Sacha. When it takes too long, she decides to take matters into her own hands and build it herself, which leads to bouncy chaos!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in a kitchen, where they watch a lady decorating cupcakes. When she is finished, she puts away all the cake decorations in cupboards and drawers around the kitchen, while the Twirlywoos look on with interest. When she leaves the room, they decide to put the cakes away too and hide them in different places around the kitchen until they are all gone. The lady comes back with a crowd of children and finds the cakes are missing. The children spot one of the hidden cakes and a treasure hunt ensues as they uncover them all. The Hooter calls the Twirlywoos home as the children eat their cakes, and now they really are all gone! Toodloo pumps up the Tea Machine, but all that appears on top is a tiny grape. The tea that comes out is just enough to fill Great BigHoo's cup and he drinks it all - only to find that there is none left for the others! Toodloo goes back to get more tea, but again she only gets enough to fill Great BigHoo's cup. Finally, Chickedy and Chick run over to operate the machine. They continue to pump it up until a whole bunch of grapes appears, and there is enough tea for everyone.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends are at a racetrack, where they have lots of fun with different types of bicycles. Meanwhile, the Tumbles are getting ready for the Great Golden Egg Race.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies have fun moving backwards and forwards. The Tubby Custard Ride goes forwards, then backwards, then forwards again!

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Amber, Amelia, Arthur, DJ, Zadie, Betsy, Indianna and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Leaves which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate leaves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The song ‘All the leaves are falling down’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and a group of deaf and hearing children meet in Tall Trees Forest to make cheeky pop-up weasel puppets, then they sing and sign Pop Goes the Weasel, learning the signs for rice and weasel.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Isla and Abbie embark on an exciting spring adventure around the garden, discovering the abundance of colours popping up in their inner-city oasis. But why does the garden become more colourful during spring? Our very own gardening guru, Chatterpot, provides answers to their horticultural questions.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca washes all the hats, ready for a silly hat party - but Murphi’s special party hat has shrunk. Although he’s disappointed, it gives Murphi an idea - a clothes peg giraffe. The Mini Monsters are using everyday things to create great makes, and a call comes in on the Magic Monster Mirror from Rebecca’s aunt. Murphi’s mega monster make is a fun woolly head game inspired by scraps of wool delivered by the Recycling Express.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger discovers some unexpected guests hiding in her tail - three baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious X-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy, leaving Bluey no choice but to operate immediately!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up at the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown. He puts on a magic show for the Squirrels, making things appear and disappear to enthusiastic requests.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to an old mill. On the way, they go puddle splashing, race sticks in the river, make echoes and escape the snakes!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Freddie and Mum paint colourful dinosaur eggs and organise a tricky treasure hunt for brother George. Will George use his dino knowledge to find all of the hidden eggs and dinosaurs? Later, the boys pretend to be pirates and go in search of another type of treasure. Aboard their pirate ships, they race across a vast boating lake. But who will make it back to shore first? And will they find the pirates' gold coins?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Talib is cooking a recipe that his mum has taught him - a colourful Tanzanian banana curry. After lots of chopping and mixing in the kitchen, Talib decorates a beautiful Tanzanian-themed table complete with gold animals. He also greets his friends with a greeting spoken in Swahili, a language spoken in Tanzania. Unripened bananas are an important ingredient in his curry, but not all of his friends are keen on the taste when they try it at first. Will they like the cooked dish?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is sending a letter in the post to the CBeebies house. She finds out how posting a letter works as she follows the letter's journey from the post box to the sorting office and finally to the house. Using a special infrared light, Maddie shows us how stamps are scanned to tell if they are first or second class. Next, she visits a factory where colouring pencils are made. She finds out how the coloured crayon inside is made from clay and, using her slow-motion camera, we see the wooden shaft of the pencil being made.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means he doesn’t hear everything. Diesel is trained to listen out for important sounds that Rayane might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears. Together, they’re unstoppable! Diesel and Rayane are off to the park, where their football team are doing a sponsored fun run to raise the funds for a new kit. Diesel has a busy day ahead. First, he has to filter out all the sounds in the busy park to help Rayane find his friends Grace and Karim and the rest of his teammates at the start line. Then, he has to listen for the klaxon so he can let Rayane know the race is starting. He doesn’t want him to get left behind! Rayane’s football coach uses British Sign Language to communicate the rules of the race to the runners before they set off. Diesel has to run alongside Rayane and alert him to any danger or to anyone trying to get past. Karim is leading the field until he takes a wrong turn – and Rayane and Diesel set off in hot pursuit. Can they catch their friend and help him finish the race?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the heat of the jungle enclosure to meet a jewel of the jungle, the golden-headed lion tamarin. As they get closer, they see how these miniature monkeys get their name - they have a beautiful, golden mane just like a lion! Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet up with another colourful animal, the poison dart frog. These frogs come in many amazing colours, and they get to meet some blue coloured dart frogs. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: While Zoe helps Doug with his homework project about Alaska, Simon and Jess take Waffle and Evie to the shops to buy new school shoes. But Waffle's attempts to help end up causing chaos.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona helps Bernie impress his lady friend, Bernadette, with a delicious meal.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. The Small Potatoes conga their way through a fantastical world filled with fruit.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee and TapTap try to track down the source of a strange chirping noise in the garden.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Nana and Dado ask Maddie and Triggs to help prune Mum's willow tree, they are shocked to learn that this means cutting off all its branches! Their shock soon turns to delight when they learn pruning will help the tree, and they are even more delighted by all the wonderful things Dado can make with the branches.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about an action hero called Jet Rocket who always saves the day by smashing and crashing things. But there are other ways to save the day!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One is looking through her telescope and spots One Hundred zooming through the sky, splitting into different Numberblocks. But how many numbers can One Hundred make? On a musical journey through space, One Hundred shows One all the numbers she has inside.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Finding Alphablock N at a loose end, Letter Team OW (as in ‘blow’) helps him find new things to do. They play in the SNOW and SLOW down snowballs so that N can dodge them more easily. They build a MAN out of snow, but he is very small, so they make him GROW. As he gets bigger, the snowman comes alive and starts to dance. Soon, to the delight of the Alphablocks, he is putting on a spectacular SHOW. What a showman! N has never had a nicer day.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends are on a pirate adventure – searching for buried treasure! Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is struggling to decide which story to read to Tumble Ted.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie, Dan and Jaqui are in Sussex helping Tim who wants to sell his girlfriend Sally's lifetime of collections behind her back. A mother of four, Sally runs a 500-year-old pub and has a reputation for putting on incredible themed nights - but her creative flair has got the better of their home upstairs. The living room is full of unique items that Sally's collected over the years but Tim is yearning for it to go to create a relaxed space away from their hectic lives running the pub. Whilst Sally's shopping to her heart's content in London, Josie and the team rummage through her curated collections. With Star Wars toys in their original packaging, an array of vintage cameras and even an original Space Hopper, Josie's concerned that Sally won't be able to let go of her possessions, but Tim doesn't hold back. Arriving home to discover all her treasures have been boxed up and valued, Sally faces the ultimate dilemma: does she keep her collections or is the cash worth the sacrifice?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: 23-year-old Dianne Price is found drowned in her bath, wrapped in net curtains, and made to look like a bride with a ring on her finger, a bouquet of cheap flowers on a toilet seat, and a chilling message written in lipstick on the bathroom mirror - Barnaby and Jones begin their investigation and find no shortage of possible culprits. While Barnaby ponders the similarity of the case to a string of murders from 1912, Jones struggles with his new boss's love of psychology - the case then leads the detectives to a donkey sanctuary and a pub run by an ex-copper and former madam. When local vet Fran Carter is murdered at a heritage steam railway site - and her body decorated with confetti - Barnaby finds parallels with another decades-old case... could history be repeating itself? It is not long before there are more shocking deaths, and Barnaby and Jones must work fast if they are to catch the killer before it is too late.

programme.title: DCI Banks
programme.desc: Gritty detective series based on novels by Peter Robinson. An internal investigation threatens to break up the team as Annie is ordered to scrutinise Helen's role in the operation - as a consequence, professional divisions are made worse by the fledgling romantic relationship between Annie and Banks. Meanwhile, news that the gun has recently been fired leaves the DCI searching for the owner and its potential victim - on the trail of a notorious villain, Banks discovers a connection which brings the case worryingly close to home.

programme.title: DCI Banks

Meanwhile, DS Annie Cabbot completes her investigation into DI Helen Morton's role in a botched operation, resulting in Helen's immediate suspension and driving the rift between Annie and Banks deeper - Al then makes an offer to help Banks to get his daughter back and the detective finds himself contemplating breaking every rule in the book to meet Al's demands.
